style: Sléndro-informed five-step field modal drone with microtonal beating and bitonal layer separation, alternating with sharp chromatic side-steps. Angular cabaret patter combined with lexical tone contours, glottalized vowel leaps, and hocketed vocal counterpoint. Motorik asymmetric pulse featuring competing entrainment clocks, stampede rhythmic density, and periodic abrupt silence cuts. Fluorescent ballast hum, shift-register noise channel, magnetic tape loop, 8-bit pulse-wave synth, cristal baschet, thunder sheet, large sheet metal, and spring reverb tank as instrument, with role exchange from production artifact to hook and register-based form. Trashy cheap spectacle performed straight under extreme panic-under-function pressure. Leader plus distorted echo group with Akan-influenced L1 phonological transfer, obsessive glottal stops, high-dimension clicks, and tiny inventory phonotactic compression. High stemminess and kinetic velocity across dense multi-channel frequency distribution
